title: Functional identities of degree 2 at two-sided zero products on incidence algebras
summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring with unity such that $\frac{1}{2}\in R$. Let $X$ be a connected finite poset with $|X|>2$ and $I(X,R)$ be the incidence algebra of $X$ over $R$. In this paper, we characterize the forms of linear maps $F_1,F_2,F_3,F_4:I(X,R)\to I(X,R)$ satisfying \[ F_1(f)g+fF_2(g)+F_3(g)f+gF_4(f)=0, \] whenever $fg=gf=0$. We prove that the $F_i$'s are of the so-called standard form if and only if any two edges in the comparability graph of $X$ are contained in one cycle.
